title: vesuvius-inkcheck: the Ink Recoverability Protocol (IRP) for Herculaneum ink maps
description: CPU-only validation of Vesuvius Challenge ink-detection maps: registers a predicted ink map to a published reference of the same segment (possibly at a different resolution) and tests band-pass correlation, AUC and stroke recall against search-matched shift nulls, with negative controls, a saturation warning and a versioned per-segment report schema (ink card v1).
